needsChange: This needs a change before it can be asked
checkFirst: Nobody has asked this yet, but check this first
changeAbove: Change your question in the search box above, then search again.

checks.link: Questions can't contain links, including shortened or spelled-out ones. Name the source in words instead, like "an article in the New York Times".
checks.personal_email: Questions can't include email addresses, so nobody can be contacted or identified through one.
checks.personal_phone: Questions can't include phone numbers, so nobody can be contacted or identified through one.
checks.personal_handle: Questions can't include social media handles, which point at one person's account.
checks.personal_address: Questions can't include street addresses, which point at someone's home.
checks.too_long: Questions can be at most {max} characters; this one is {length}. Try cutting it to the one claim you want answered.
checks.too_short: That's too short to be a question. Say the whole claim, like "Is the Great Wall of China visible from space?"
checks.open_ended: Questions starting with "{word}" ask for an explanation, and BeliefAtlas questions need a true-or-false answer. Ask about one claim, starting with a word like "Is", "Did", "Will" or "Does".
checks.statement: This reads as a statement. BeliefAtlas questions need a true-or-false answer, so start with a word like "Is", "Did", "Will" or "Does".
checks.obscene: Questions can't swear. Take out “{word}”; the question works without it.
checks.obscene_fix: Questions can't swear. Try “{fix}” instead of “{word}”.
checks.too_specific_relation: Only you know “{where}”, so nobody else can answer this. Ask it about {fix} in general.
checks.too_specific_self: “{where}” asks about you, and only you can answer that. For everyone, it becomes “{fix}”.
checks.hateful_slur: “{word}” is a slur. Questions can't use slurs; if the question is about a group of people, call them by their own name.
checks.hateful_dehumanising: Questions can't call a group of people vermin, animals or less than human. Ask about a specific claim or policy instead.
checks.hateful_violence: Questions can't call for violence against a group of people.
checks.harassing: This insults {name}, who may be a private person. Questions can't insult or demean people.
checks.private_person: This points at a private person and accuses them of something. Questions can't target private people; ask about the behaviour in general.
checks.spam: This reads as advertising. Questions are for claims people can answer true or false, not for promoting anything.
